snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000 : Speed Freeks | Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks hits PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on May 21, 2026.

It’s loud. It’s fast. It’s full Orky chaos.

Full cross-play means everyone’s thrown into the same warzone, whether you’re on console or PC. Bigger fights, more explosions, zero excuses.

Drive like a maniac. Shoot everything. Join the SPEEDWAAAGH!

Wishlist on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10016640
Wishlist on XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/Warhammer-40000-speed-freeks/9PD4F5G2LM93
PLAY NOW STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2078450/Warhammer_40000_Speed_Freeks/

The mayhem doesn’t stop there; following its May 21st digital release, in partnership with PM Studios, Wired Productions also is proud to announce an exclusive physical retail edition of Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks for PlayStation 5, launching on June 16th, 2026. This brings full-throttle Ork vehicle combat to store shelves worldwide. 

Retail: https://wiredproductions.com/games/warhammer-40000-speed-freeks/#where-to-buy
